#   tool-jar                 downloaded and verified at generation only, never committed
#   go-module                sha256 column holds the go.sum h1: hash (base64 SHA-256 dirhash)

#   local-file               a file of this module (id tests:tools/grammar-oracle/<path>): a pinned copy (source/revision name the original) or a local patch; re-hashed

# manifest_test.go TestPinnedFiles re-hashes every grammar-file, license-header, local-file and s6-table row.
# Sibling paths are repo-qualified (sh:, bashsharp:, bashy:, tests:), never absolute.
